art_style.composition: Portrait-oriented trading card art; centered heroic subject; readable silhouette; atmospheric background; clear focal light.
art_style.palette: Obsidian navy, jungle teal, volcanic red, moon gold, parchment highlights.
art_style.lighting: Warm gold rim light against deep cinematic shadows; subtle mythic glow behind the subject.
art_style.finish: Painterly cinematic fantasy realism with crisp face and costume detail, restrained background texture, no modern logos or text in the artwork.
art_style.prompt_template: Philippine mythic fantasy card illustration of {SUBJECT}, {ROLE}, inspired by the archipelago's landscape and folklore, centered heroic portrait, dark cinematic obsidian and teal atmosphere, warm gold rim light, dramatic readable silhouette, painterly high-detail trading-card art, no text, no watermark.
art_style.negative_prompt: photorealistic celebrity, modern clothing, flat icon, chibi, blurry subject, illegible face, watermark, logo, typography, oversaturated neon, copied existing artwork
